summary: Winston County, MS tower; the Register lists a 100 ft Aermotor LS-40 registered in 2022 with lower treads removed and the site vacated by the MFC, possibly now timber-owned.

facts.design: 100 ft Aermotor LS-40 with a straight internal staircase, 14 landings and 15 flights
facts.status_note: Standing at the July 2022 site visit, but lower treads were removed and many treads were missing; no later report found

access.note: Register says the MFC vacated the site and it is possibly owned by a timber company; treat as private until the owner is confirmed

visit.trail_note: Lower treads removed and many treads missing at the 2022 visit; do not climb

events.note: Registered July 10, 2022 as US 1662, MS 27 after a July 9, 2022 site visit

evidence.supports: 100 ft Aermotor LS-40 with a straight internal staircase
evidence.quote: 100ft Aermotor Ls-40 with a straight internal staircase

evidence.supports: lower treads removed and many treads missing
evidence.quote: Lower treads were removed, many treads missing

evidence.supports: site vacated by the MFC, possibly owned by a timber company
evidence.quote: The site was vacated by the MFC, possibly owned by a timber company

evidence.supports: administered by the Mississippi Forestry Commission

notes_for_editor: Single source (NHLR). Two searches found nothing else on this tower. The date the MFC vacated the site and the current owner are unknown; the 'private' access level rests on the Register's 'possibly owned by a timber company' wording. The 'standing' status rests only on the July 2022 visit. The Register's own admin and vacated statements conflict in tone (administered by MFC, yet vacated by MFC), so the story states both.
